PrayerGuide.title: 🌿 COMPLETE FIVE DAILY PRAYERS GUIDE
PrayerGuide.subtitle: (with Arabic recitation)
PrayerGuide.recitationsTitle: ✨ Surahs and Prayers Recited in Prayer

sunnatRakats.title: Sunnah (2 rak'ahs)
sunnatRakats.niyat: I intend to pray the two rak'ahs Sunnah of Fajr prayer for the sake of Allah.
steps: 1st rak'ah: Subhanaka, Al-Fatiha, short surah (Ikhlas), ruku', sajdah.
2nd rak'ah: Al-Fatiha, short surah (Kawthar), ruku', sajdah.
Tashahhud, Salawat, Dua, Salam.

Tashahhud, Salawat, Dua, Salam.

dhuhr.title: 2. DHUHR PRAYER
dhuhr.description: 4 rak'ahs Sunnah, 4 rak'ahs Fard, 2 rak'ahs Sunnah

Tashahhud, Salawat, Dua, Salam in 4th rak'ah.

farzRakats.title: Wajib (3 rak'ahs)
farzRakats.niyat: I intend to pray the three rak'ahs Wajib of Witr prayer for the sake of Allah.
steps: 1st rak'ah: Subhanaka, Al-Fatiha, short surah (Ikhlas), ruku', sajdah.
2nd rak'ah: Al-Fatiha, short surah (Kawthar), ruku', sajdah, Tashahhud.
3rd rak'ah: Al-Fatiha, short surah, before ruku' raise hands and recite Qunut prayer, then ruku', sajdah.
Tashahhud, Salawat, Dua, Salam.

subhanaka.title: Subhanaka
subhanaka.content: Subhanakallohumma va bihamdik, va tabarokasmuk, va ta'ala jadduk, va la ilaha g'oyruk.

fatiha.title: Surah Al-Fatiha
fatiha.content:
Bismillahir rohmanir rohim.
1. Alhamdulillahi robbil 'aalamiyn 
2. Ar-rohmaanir rohiym 
3. Maaliki yavmiddiyn 
4. Iyyaaka na'budu va iyyaaka nasta'iyn. 
5. Ihdinas-sirootol mustaqiym 
6-7. Sirootol-laziyna an'amta 'alayhim g'oyril mag'zuubi 'alayhim valazzolliyn. Omin.

ikhlas.title: Surah Al-Ikhlas
ikhlas.content:
Qul huvallohu ahad.
Allohu somad.
Lam yalid va lam yulad.
Va lam yakun lahu kufuvan ahad.

kawthar.title: Surah Al-Kawthar
kawthar.content:
Inna a'taynaka-l-kawthar.
Fasalli li-robbika vanhar.
Inna shani'aka huval-abtar.

tashahhud.title: Attahiyyat (Tashahhud)
tashahhud.content:
Attahiyyatu lillahi vassalavatu vattoyyibat.
Assalamu 'alayka ayyuhan-nabiyyu va rohmatullahi va barokatuh.
Assalamu 'alayna va 'ala ibadillahissolihin.
Ashhadu alla ilaha illallohu va ashhadu anna Muhammadan abduhu va rosuluh.

At-tahiyyātu lillāhi was-salawātu wat-tayyibāt,
As-salāmu 'alayka ayyuhan-nabiyyu wa raḥmatullāhi wa barakātuh,
As-salāmu 'alaynā wa 'alā 'ibādillāhiṣ-ṣāliḥīn,
Ashhadu allā ilāha illallāh,
Wa ashhadu anna Muḥammadan 'abduhū wa rasūluh.

salawat.title: Salawat
salawat.content:
Allohumma solli 'ala Muhammadin va 'ala ali Muhammadin.
Kama sollayta 'ala Ibrohima va 'ala ali Ibrohim.
Innaka hamidum majid.
Allohumma barik 'ala Muhammadin va 'ala ali Muhammadin.
Kama barokta 'ala Ibrohima va 'ala ali Ibrohim.
Innaka hamidum majid. 

Allāhumma ṣalli 'alā Muḥammadin wa 'alā āli Muḥammad,
Kamā ṣallayta 'alā Ibrāhīma wa 'alā āli Ibrāhīm,
Innaka ḥamīdum-majīd.

Allāhumma bārik 'alā Muḥammadin wa 'alā āli Muḥammad,
Kamā bārakta 'alā Ibrāhīma wa 'alā āli Ibrāhīm,
Innaka ḥamīdum-majīd.

dua.title: Dua
dua.content: Robbana atina fid-dunya hasanatan, va fil-akhirati hasanatan, va qina 'azaban-nar.

qunut.title: Qunut Prayer
qunut.content:
Allohumma inna nasta'iynuka va nastaghfiruka va nu'minu bika va natavakkalu 'alayka va nusniy 'alaykal-khayr, kullahu nashkuruka va la nakfuruk, va nakhla'u va natruku may-yafjuruk.

Allohumma iyyaka na'budu va laka nusolli va nasjudu va ilayka nas'a va nahfidu, narju rohmataka, va nakhsha 'azabaka, inna 'azabaka bil-kuffari mulhiq.

notes: In each sajdah, say 'Subhana robbiyal a'la' 3 times.
In each ruku', say 'Subhana robbiyal azim' 3 times.
Reciting a short surah after Surah Al-Fatiha is Sunnah.
